answer: PUF silicon fingerprints gate epoch seats: each identity enrolls 64 challenge-response pairs from one physical die, and admission demands a fresh 128-bit reply under 5 voltage and temperature corners. A farm spinning 1000 clones needs 1000 distinct dies at ~$18 each plus 5000 probe-hours, costing $18,000 before one seat clears. A farm cannot share one die across clones or bulk-buy responses because enrollment is chip-unique and non-exportable. Detected clusters forfeit bonds and face a 20-epoch exclusion. Like an oasis of crystal trust, fraud hangs by a thread.
